title: 第23章 再次谋划第24章 女装
content_zh:
见长卿如此纠结，洛红颜有些无奈。
“你难道没听懂我刚刚说的话么，那柳露不可能有血魔灵的，你实在是杞人忧天。”
长卿没有应声，他依然在思考。
洛红颜的分析是很对的，血法修士在世间销声匿迹千万年，即使曾经真的有误入百花洞的血法修士带给了柳露一枚血魔灵，柳露也喂养不起。
但是这分析和现实存在明显的漏洞，事实上柳露就是有一枚血魔灵。
那么问题出现在哪里？
等等......
“你说，柳露有没有可能豢养了一个强大的血法修士，只要定期去抽取他体内的血气来喂养血魔灵，不就可以了么？”
“毕竟她的血魔灵只有一种渠道获得，就是有血法修士误入到了百花洞里，柳露夺走了他的血魔灵。”
“既然能夺走御灵，为什么不能把那个血法修士也像牲畜一样豢养起来呢。”
洛红颜扶额。
“你是白痴么，首先，如果先天的本命灵被夺走了，修士就会立刻随之死亡，修士死亡之后，尸体也就不能持续产生血气了，喂养不了血魔灵这么多年。”
“也有可能血魔灵不是那个修士的本命灵。”长卿反问道。
“那就更不可能了，血魔灵是地灵，本命灵一般都是修士体内最强的灵，如果连血魔灵这种级别的地灵都不是他的本命灵，那这个修士最低也是须臾级别的强者，这样的存在，柳露对付都对付不了，何谈豢养。”
长卿却不这么认为。
如果排除所有不可能，剩下的那个结果就算再离奇，也是真相。
他已经可以肯定，这百花洞中，一定存在某个极其强大的血法修士，被柳露用什么方式豢养了起来。
虽然没法依靠他和洛红颜的力量直接破解血魔灵，但是得知了这么多有用的信息已经足够了。
越是死局，越需要变量。
越对自己不利的局面，越要改变，只要改变，就是好事。

而一个被豢养起来的血法强者，无疑是一个巨大的变量，给了他很多可以操作的空间。
“计划暂时就这样说定了，四大护法和血魔灵的问题交给我来解决，我会哄骗柳露在炼灵的时候炸死自己，四大护法我也会一一除掉，血魔灵如果真的存在，我来想办法。”
现在说再多也没什么意义，他已经有了计划，虽然这一世的目标除了逃出去之外还多了个保护洛红颜，难度陡然增加，但他还是信心十足。
“只要你别翻译的时候在柳露面前露馅我就谢天谢地了。”
长卿挠了挠头，似乎这一世自己言语间的主动和对洛红颜的关切，让洛红颜对他产生了一些误解。
他很认真的点点头。
“放心吧，我不会让你失望的，你也要保护好自己，万事小心。”
“我俩只是合作，不用你关心我，而且说实话有点恶心......”
“额......”
......
柳露干枯的手握着一支毛笔，正按照长卿说的，在纸上歪歪扭扭的记录着。
“师傅，这移魂灵非常特殊，炼制成功之后一炷香的时间就会消散，所以必须现炼现用。”
柳露一边在纸上写下，一边疑惑道。
content_en:
Seeing Changqing so entangled, Luo Hongyan felt helpless.
"Didn't you understand what I just said? It's impossible for Liu Lu to have a blood demon spirit. You are really unfounded."
Chang Qing didn't respond, he was still thinking.
Luo Hongyan's analysis was correct. Blood magic monks had disappeared from the world for tens of millions of years. Even if a blood magic monk accidentally entered Baihua Cave and brought Liu Lu a blood demon spirit, Liu Lu couldn't afford to feed it.
However, there are obvious loopholes between this analysis and reality. In fact, Liu Lu has a blood demon spirit.
So where does the problem arise?
Wait...
"Tell me, is it possible that Liu Lu has raised a powerful blood magic monk? As long as he regularly extracts the blood from his body to feed the blood demon spirit, wouldn't that be enough?"
"After all, there is only one way to obtain her blood demon spirit, that is, a blood magic monk accidentally entered the Baihua Cave, and Liu Lu took away his blood demon spirit."
"Since you can take away the imperial spirit, why can't you raise that blood magic monk like an animal?"
Luo Hongyan held her forehead.
"Are you an idiot? First of all, if the innate soul is taken away, the monk will die immediately. After the monk dies, the corpse will not be able to continue to produce blood and can't feed the blood demon spirit for so many years."
"It's also possible that the blood demon spirit is not the monk's natal spirit." Chang Qing asked rhetorically.
"Then it's even more impossible. The blood demon spirit is an earth spirit, and the natal spirit is generally the strongest spirit in a monk's body. If even the earth spirit at the level of the blood demon spirit is not his natal spirit, then this monk is at least a strong person at the level of Xuyu. Liu Lu can't deal with such a being, so let's talk about raising him."
Chang Qing doesn't think so.
If all impossibilities are eliminated, the remaining result, no matter how bizarre, is still the truth.
He was already certain that there must be an extremely powerful blood magic cultivator in the Hundred Flowers Cave, who was raised by Liu Lu in some way.
Although he and Luo Hongyan could not directly crack the blood demon spirit with their strength, it was enough to learn so much useful information.
The more deadlocked the situation, the more variables are needed.
The more unfavorable the situation is to you, the more you need to change it. As long as you change it, it is a good thing.
And a raised blood magic expert is undoubtedly a huge variable, giving him a lot of room to operate.
"The plan is settled for now. Let me solve the problem of the four guardians and the blood demon spirits. I will trick Liu Lu into blowing herself up while refining the spirit. I will also get rid of the four guardians one by one. If the blood demon spirits really exist, I will find a solution."
There is no point in saying more now. He already has a plan. Although his goal in this life is to protect Luo Hongyan in addition to escaping, and the difficulty suddenly increases, he is still confident.
"As long as you don't expose your secrets in front of Liu Lu while translating, I'll be thankful."
Changqing scratched his head. It seemed that his initiative in speaking and concern for Luo Hongyan in this life caused Luo Hongyan to misunderstand him.
He nodded seriously.
"Don't worry, I won't let you down. You have to protect yourself and be careful."
"We are just cooperating, you don't need to care about me, and to be honest, it's a bit disgusting..."
"Um..."
...
Liu Lu's withered hand held a writing brush, and she was writing crookedly on the paper as Chang Qing said.
"Master, this soul-moving spirit is very special. After it is successfully refined, it will dissipate within a stick of incense, so it must be refined and used now."
Liu Lu wondered while writing on the paper.
